pieces.Text: You learn to manipulate fate simply by drawing a card from the uniquely crafted harrow deck you gained when you became an augur. To use this ability, draw a card from a harrow deck as a standard action. You can draw a card from a harrow deck in this manner
times per day, but you can only have one trump active at any one time. If you draw a card to which you do not know the trump, you gain no bonus.
